items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: Muddy's church. I know I was down there on St. Anthony Street.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's been out. He belongs to your mother's church you said? No, we call her Muddy. Oh, Muddy. Her church is downtown.
She's a member of, how you call that church? Muddy's church. I know I was down there on St. Anthony Street.
Did you ever play any music in church? Oh man.
